source.title: Night Falls
source.description: If you'll walk with me, I have one last thing to show you.
source.objective: Walk with Estelenn and see what she has to show you.
source.progress: I promise this won't take long.
source.completion:
It's over at last. Finally, I can rest.

Van Amburgh killed me some time ago, you see. But I could not pass on while he inflicted such suffering on his animal minions. I had to find someone who understood animals like I did, who lived like I did, and I found you.

I must go, but before I do, I have one last thing for you. I was buried here, and I want you to take my swords, the last thing I left behind.

Go with the green.
